status: Prepared; revised browser acceptance is pending.

preservation.method: Exact byte copy made before edits.

syntheticCards.source: Constructed in the isolated test page; no card file is read or retained.

preparedAssertions: One initial load transfers distinct owned firmware and two SD buffers exactly once, while caller buffers stay attached.
Raw Worker loaded/status/trace replies contain both admitted SD profiles, capacity, read-only flag, presence and board-owned routes.
Request observers omit firmware bytes and expose only SD profile/capacity/read-only metadata; snapshot observers contain safe scalar SD diagnostics.
Fresh initial/reset/update snapshots, updater receipt snapshots and before/after traces retain both card metadata entries.
Undocumented SD fields, binary buffers/views and non-scalar SD diagnostics fail before raw card content can enter retained evidence.
Observer and incoming-reply counts must be nonzero; observer failures are collected because subscribers cannot throw into RPC.
reviewCorrection: The binary privacy scan guards SharedArrayBuffer availability for pages without cross-origin isolation.

targetedStrictTyping.command: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --allowImportingTsExtensions --skipLibCheck --lib ES2022,DOM --types node tests/emulator-worker-roundtrip.spec.ts

limits: This receipt prepares assertions and records source preservation; it does not report a revised browser result.
No guest SD command, content read, filesystem compatibility, physical card or SD power-cycle result is qualified.
Root owns the isolated production Worker browser execution and its separate acceptance receipt.
